title: ID0420891-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P3 170000422] Payment terminal error
description:
Reported issue: payment terminal error
Solution:
This is a rejection of the Payment Terminal because it don't know the Transaction number this fault can only be resolved when the charger runs in debug mode. When customer states ot that the Payment Terminal went to debug mode at the reffered time stamp, then it needs a clarification with CCV support directly.
Solution:
CCV updated the terminal firmware
Update 13/May - ES talking PLM to understand how to contact CCV and address these issues

additional_info.subject: Note created on 4/25/2025 8:55:56 AM UTC by Marius Schneider [contact:698d91f6-5322-ee11-9967-0022489de400]
Additonal notes
additional_info.body:
Hi Siemens Support Team,
we have a customer complaint about a failed card transaction on charger with ID uoQAdw.
The charger has an integrated CCV contactless payment terminal, model CCV OPM-C60.
The customer authorized a charging session via Girocard via EMVS token "EMVS*55804354*001214", receipt number 0561.
Then, the payment terminal went into diagnosis mode and made a daily closing which led the running card transaction to fail. The charging session was therefore not billed correctly, the customer was invoiced the full 50€ preauthorization amount.
Please check why the terminal went into diagnosis mode. What was the behavior of the charger during timestamp 17.04.2025 @ 11:55:14 +02:00?
Thanks and kind regards,
Marius Schneider
Software Version: v6.0.3-0-g215cb74+APN (PRODUCTION)
OCPP Backend Connection: Yes
